model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 (left) illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values that fall below a specific threshold, comparing the sparsity ratio before and after the gating mechanism is applied across different layers of a neural network. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The figure contains three distinct lines: a green dashed line with circular markers representing the "sparsity ratio before gate," which starts at a value of approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and decreases to about 0.44 at layer 20; a red dashed line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after gate," which begins at a value of approximately 0.98 at layer 0 and decreases to about 0.44 at layer 20; and a black dashed line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after average gate," which starts at approximately 0.98 at layer 0 and decreases to about 0.13 at layer 20. All three lines show a general downward trend as the layer number increases.
model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 5 (left) displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values that are below a specified threshold (1e-2) after the gating mechanism has been applied, plotted against the layer number. The x-axis represents the layer, ranging from 0 to 20 in increments of 5, with the label "Layer". The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, scaled from 0.0 to 1.0, with the label "Sparsity Ratio". The figure includes three distinct lines: a solid black line with circle markers representing the sparsity ratio before gating, which starts at a value of approximately 0.8 and remains relatively stable across all layers; a dashed black line with square markers representing the sparsity ratio after gating, which starts at approximately 0.4 and shows a slight increase towards the end of the network; and a dotted black line with triangle markers representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which starts at approximately 0.4 and remains relatively constant throughout the layers.
model_annotations.English: Figure 5 (left) is a line plot that illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2, as a function of the network layer. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three distinct lines, each representing a different metric: a dashed green line for the "sparsity ratio before gate," a solid red line for the "sparsity ratio after gate," and a dashed blue line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate." The dashed green line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and remains relatively constant, showing a slight increase to about 0.98 by layer 20. The solid red line begins at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.95 and exhibits a steady, gradual decline, reaching a value of about 0.75 at layer 20. The dashed blue line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.95 and also shows a gradual decline, ending at a value of about 0.65 at layer 20.
model_annotations.German: Figure 5 (left) displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers of a neural network. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number and ranges from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 and is also on a linear scale. The figure contains three distinct lines: a dashed green line representing the sparsity ratio before gating, which starts at approximately 0.9 and decreases gradually to around 0.4 by layer 20; a dashed blue line for the sparsity ratio after gating, which begins at about 0.4 and shows a slight increase to approximately 0.55 at layer 20; and a solid black line for the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which starts at around 0.44 and increases to about 0.55 by layer 20.
